ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.label.context_note: Conversation menu. Heads the three-level choice of how often the READER'S OWN AI agent (chief of staff) is woken in this conversation; the rows below it complete the phrase ("Wake your agent for: every message"). Distinct from the reader's own notification preferences above it, which are about the reader's banners, not the agent. WAKE CONTRACT: 'all' = the agent is woken for every message; 'mention' = woken for @-mentions of it and for replies in threads it follows; 'mute' = never woken here, not even by an @-mention.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.label.context_role: menu section heading / radio group label
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.label.context_length: 3-4 words; the radio rows complete it as a sentence.

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.all.context_note: Completes 'Wake your agent for'. The agent is woken for every message here and decides for itself whether to reply. Do not add '(default)'. WAKE CONTRACT: 'all' = the agent is woken for every message; 'mention' = woken for @-mentions of it and for replies in threads it follows; 'mute' = never woken here, not even by an @-mention.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.all.context_length: 1-3 words; one line in a ~190px label.

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.mention.context_note: Completes 'Wake your agent for'. The agent is woken when someone @-mentions it AND for replies in threads it follows ('its threads' = threads the agent follows). Keep '@-mentions' as the product's mention term. WAKE CONTRACT: 'all' = the agent is woken for every message; 'mention' = woken for @-mentions of it and for replies in threads it follows; 'mute' = never woken here, not even by an @-mention.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.mention.context_length: Up to 5 words; one line in a ~190px label.

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.mute.context_note: The agent is never woken in this conversation, not even by an @-mention. 'Never' answers 'Wake your agent for'; the parenthetical names the state with the app's Mute term. WAKE CONTRACT: 'all' = the agent is woken for every message; 'mention' = woken for @-mentions of it and for replies in threads it follows; 'mute' = never woken here, not even by an @-mention.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.mute.context_length: 1-3 words; one line in a ~190px label.

ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.error.value: Couldn’t save your agent’s wake setting. Try again.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.error.context_note: A refused write of the reader's own agent's wake level. The menu has closed and the previous level is restored; this line explains why and names WHICH setting (how often the agent wakes). Mirrors ui.teamBridge.notify.error.
ui.teamBridge.agentNotify.error.context_role: inline error under the thread header

ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.value: Accepting lets your agent read and post in this conversation from now on. It sees every message and decides whether to reply; an @-mention means it should reply. You can change how often it wakes, or mute it.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge Invitations view. A teammate added the reader's own AI agent (chief of staff) to a channel or group; the agent cannot join until its owner accepts. The consent statement the owner agrees to by pressing Accept; the key names the participation version it is consent to (bridge_agent_participation_v2), so ANY change to this English text before it ships needs review, and after it ships needs a new version and a new key. Keep every fact: from now on the agent can read the conversation's messages AND post there; it is woken for EVERY message and judges for itself whether to reply; an @-mention means a reply is expected; the owner can change how often it is woken or mute it. Do NOT name where (the ⋯ menu): the accepted line carries that pointer, and keeping it out of this paragraph holds it to about three lines in long locales (design round 2, D6). 'Mute it' here means the agent is never woken, not even by an @-mention.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.consent.bridge.context_length: Two or three sentences; permit wrapping.

ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.value: Accepted. {agent} now sees every message here and replies when it’s relevant or @-mentioned. Change this from the conversation’s ⋯ menu.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.main_value: Accepted. {agent} is woken only when someone @-mentions it.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.context_note: Desktop Team Bridge Invitations view. A teammate added the reader's own AI agent (chief of staff) to a channel or group; the agent cannot join until its owner accepts. Once accepted, the agent sees every message and decides whether a reply is needed; an @-mention means it should reply. Outcome after Accept; same wake rule as the consent statement: the agent now receives every message and replies when relevant or when @-mentioned. The last sentence points to where the owner changes this: the conversation's ⋯ (more options) menu; keep the ⋯ glyph as is.
ui.teamBridge.invitations.accepted.context_length: One or two sentences; permit wrapping.
